Subject: Quick triage — 401 invalid API key (staging)

Hi Amanda —

Thanks for the screenshot — that helps. A few common causes and quick checks (no need to re-run your whole flow):

1) Authorization header: make sure you send 
   Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>
   (common mistake: using \"ApiKey \" or sending it as a query param)

2) Key scope & environment: confirm the key you generated is in the same workspace/environment (staging vs prod). Keys are bound to the org/workspace.

3) Key activation: some keys require a one-time activation step in the console for trial accounts — quick check: profile > API keys > status column.

4) Simple curl test you can run from any machine to isolate client vs network: 
   curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \n     -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REPLACEME>' \n     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n     -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hello"}'

If that returns 200, the issue is likely in how the SDK is configured. If you still get 401 from curl, paste the full curl command and we’ll escalate.

I’m attaching the integration-checklist.pdf with the exact env variables we check during a live session. We can do a 20–30m troubleshooting window tomorrow. I’m free:
- Tue Nov 16, 11:00 AM PST (preferred)
- Tue Nov 16, 3:00 PM PST

If you can’t do morning, share a time and we’ll accommodate.

— Diego
